reason: We do the zoo on Saturdays because it's free, and I only have weekends. I'd probably grab the free first visit, but paying $14 a kid for a play cafe feels like a lot when the zoo costs nothing.
objection: On a Saturday I'd be paying $14 per kid plus a crowd at peak time when the zoo is free, and the whole thing feels a bit Instagram for Salisbury. The weekday memberships are no use to me since I work.
would_change_my_mind: A Saturday or rainy-day price closer to $8 a kid, or a family cap per visit, and the free first visit turning out great.
